page.description: Manjaro editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: Arch-based, but released as tested snapshots with a choice of three desktops. Pick an edition, then write the 64-bit image to a stick.
pros: Arch packages with Manjaro's own testing and held-back updates.
Three desktop editions maintained from one release.
Hardware detection and driver setup included.
Rolling release: no version upgrades to plan.
cons: Rolling updates still land often; deferring them for long is not supported.
The AUR is unsupported by the project.
The Commons screenshot shows OpenRC with WindowMaker, not a stock edition.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of a Manjaro OpenRC system with the WindowMaker desktop from Wikimedia Commons. It is not a stock 26.1 edition and not a ROMinit recording: no image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted for this page.

shot.alt: Manjaro OpenRC desktop running WindowMaker with terminal windows
shot.caption: Stock screenshot of Manjaro OpenRC with WindowMaker · not a stock edition, no USB written, no boot tested.

page.status: One path per edition: the 64-bit ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk.
